title: An untracked part with two bins keeps both bins and quantities after reopening
custom_preconds:
• Signed in as Admin at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number, pick a Category, then type Cost 1.50.
  2. Switch Track quantities and cost of goods OFF.
  3. Set the default bin (General Storage) Quantity to 4.
  4. Click + Add Bin Location, pick another bin (for example A1A) and set Quantity 2.
  5. Click Save, then search the part number.
  6. Click the row to reopen the part.
custom_expected:
Step 5:

  • The row shows Not Tracked in Total Qty and the bin chip reads General Storage 4 with +1.

Step 6:

  • Track quantities and cost of goods is OFF and Min / Max are hidden.
  • Both bins are listed: General Storage 4 (Default) and A1A 2.
